messages:
Nadia (SolsticeGrid): hey team, kicking off SolsticeGrid onboarding. Main goals: ingest IoT event streams, generate 1-paragraph human summaries per device incident, and surface searchable embeddings for downstream dashboards. POC: Nadia (me). Target: pilot by 2026-05-15, scale to 2k req/day by EOM. Need clear owners and a 30/60/90 plan.

Marta (CSM): welcome Nadia! I’ll coordinate CS activities and runbook delivery. Quick ask: do you have a strict SLA requirement or a renewal milestone tied to accuracy/perf?

Nadia (SolsticeGrid): renewal talk: if pilot meets uptime & summary precision, we move to paid within 90 days. Key measurable: summary precision >= 92% on our gold prompts, P95 latency < 600ms for single-device queries.

Ishaan (Solutions Eng): I’ll lead infra & integration. Two suggestions: 1) use chat-completion for summaries with a short context window, 2) embeddings for search index. Also need sample schema for events and avg tokens per event.

Nadia (SolsticeGrid): sending sample schema & 48h sample payload to the S3 link in the kickoff invite. Avg tokens ~ 220 per event, peaks at 1k events/min during storms. Region: EU-central preferred.

Priya (Enablement): Enablement plan: two live sessions (dev workshop day 2, admin + runbooks day 10) + recorded snippets. I’ll publish a quick pre-read with required IAM roles and allowlist steps.

Ruth (Legal): flag: data retention policy needs alignment. Do you require deletion on request and data location controls? If so, Marta to capture and we may need Private deployment evaluation.

Marta (CSM): noted. Nadia, please confirm retention window and whether logs include PII. Also logging/audit needs for the compliance team. Success criteria draft I'll capture: - Accuracy >= 92% on gold set, - P95 latency <= 600ms, - <0.5% error rate at 2k req/day, - Compliance sign-off for EU data controls.

Nadia (SolsticeGrid): Logs are pseudonymized; no direct PII, retention target 90 days but may shorten if required. VPC + KMS should cover initial needs.

Ishaan (Solutions Eng): Proposed engineering milestones:

Week 0 (pre-kickoff): creds + allowlist + sample S3 access check
Week 1: ingestion pipeline + basic embedding index + smoke evals
Week 2: chat prompt templates + latency tuning + canary traffic
Week 3: rollout to pilot + monitoring dashboards + runbook handoff

Ishaan (Solutions Eng): S3 access test (paste into your Dev box):
```
aws s3 cp s3://solstice-samples/48h-sample.json ./sample.json --profile solstice-dev
```
Please confirm the file downloads.

Marta (CSM): proposing kickoff meeting Wed 11:30 CET or Thu 09:00 CET. Which works? I'll include eng lead, security contact, legal, and product.

Nadia (SolsticeGrid): Wed 11:30 CET works. Attendees: Nadia, Tomas (Eng), Priya, Ishaan, Ruth, Marta.

cal-bot: Meeting created: Wed 11:30 CET — "SolsticeGrid • Redwood Onboarding Kickoff". Invite sent.

Priya (Enablement): I’ll post the pre-read in the calendar invite: checklist items (API keys, allowlist IPs, sample S3 link, test prompts). Also will record dev session.

Ishaan (Solutions Eng): quick note on cost/perf tradeoffs — we should test with quantized model variants for cheaper bulk evaluation, and then validate final quality on full-precision. Will add to tech checklist.

Ruth (Legal): I	will review the pre-read for retention + deletion language. If VPC + KMS is insufficient for audit requirements, we	may need to scope Private eval.

Marta (CSM): action items I	have: collect security contact, request sample payload, draft success criteria & acceptance tests, and capture any legal/regulatory gaps. Posting the action tracker now.

Nadia (SolsticeGrid): thanks all. One risk to call out: burst traffic during storms may cause warm-up latency spikes. Will provide a storm traffic trace for load testing.

Marta (CSM): good call  Ill add a load-test scenario to the pilot plan. See you Wed. :rocket:
